The business case for film

A fast, low-disruption building upgrade

Compared with mechanical retrofits or glass replacement, film is quick to install and easy to budget — with benefits tenants notice immediately.

Energy efficiency

Solar and Low-E films cut heat gain and loss, easing HVAC load and reducing cooling costs across your portfolio.

Tenant comfort

Even out hot perimeter offices and sunny conference rooms — fewer complaints and better retention.

Privacy & branding

Add privacy to conference rooms and ground floors, or a clean, consistent exterior look across a facade.

Security & safety

Safety and security film can help hold broken glass together and add resistance to forced entry. Performance depends on the specific film system and any required attachment system.

Glare control

Reduce screen glare in offices and reception areas for a more productive working environment.

Anti-graffiti protection

Shield storefront glass and elevators — swap the film instead of costly glass after vandalism.

For the trade

Architects, designers, builders & property managers

Considering film during design or renovation lets glass performance, appearance and interior-protection goals be resolved earlier rather than retrofitted. We provide product consultation, film samples, glass and film compatibility review, and scheduling alongside the finishing trades.

Pellikal provides film selection and installation. We do not provide architectural or structural engineering, energy modelling, or code or legal compliance certification.
